findings.title: Palestinians bury remains of 70 people recovered from rubble in northern Gaza
findings.location: Al-Saftawi area, north of Gaza City, Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_or_system: Remains of about 70 Palestinians recovered from bombed buildings, of whom 60 reportedly identified; bereaved families and local recovery teams
findings.incident_type: Recovery, identification and funeral of pre-existing conflict fatalities; NOT 70 newly killed
findings.exact_supporting_passage: residents and local teams had recovered around 70 bodies, including 60 whose identities had been established
findings.source_type: Palestinian news agency firsthand correspondent report; Associated Press independently described a vigil for remains of 70 on Saturday

bounded_discovery_context.discovery_method: Direct read of WAFA English/Arabic latest-news listings, following OCHA OPT/WHO official checks and twelve bounded targeted searches
bounded_discovery_context.corroboration: AP already described a vigil for the remains of 70 Palestinians on Saturday, Nov 14; WAFA's Sunday item adds that 60 had been identified and says the funeral was Sunday. Time/day distinction is not independently resolved.
bounded_discovery_context.importance: Humanitarian recovery and identification milestone. The 70 must not be added to newly occurring death totals, nor described as casualties from a new strike.
bounded_discovery_context.limitations: Exact recovery dates and original deaths are not established; whether AP Saturday vigil and WAFA Sunday funeral are distinct events is unclear; identification figure currently one-source.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary recall only; not primary publisher/collector. No publication, approvals or schedule changes.
